daten.Du hast einen kleinen Schlüssel gefunden: You found a small key! It opens a locked door.
daten.Ein Herzcontainer! Du hast jetzt ein Her: A heart container! You now have one more heart, and all your hearts are full again.
daten.Der große Schlüssel! Er öffnet die verzi: The big key! It opens the ornate door to the heart of the dungeon.
daten.Du hast eine Laterne gefunden! In dunkle: You found a lantern! It lights your way in dark rooms.
daten.Die Fuchsfeste! Ganz oben haust der Scha: The Fox Fortress! The Shadow Fox lives at the very top. You only have a dagger - find a sword along the way. Space: stab, read, open.
West: Well Room. North: Thorn Yard. The east wing is bolted from the other side - one day you will come back that way.
daten.Ein Kristallschalter: schlag ihn, dann t: A crystal switch: strike it and the blue and orange pegs swap. Its color counts throughout the whole fortress!
daten.Büsche versperren den Weg. Stich sie mit: Bushes block the way. Cut them down with your dagger - sometimes there is a heart inside.
daten.Die Tür im Norden ist verschlossen. Den: The north door is locked. Foxes guard the key in the guard room to the west.
daten.Die Tür fällt zu! Besiege die Wachen - d: The door slams shut! Defeat the guards - then you will see what they are guarding.
daten.Schieb den Steinblock auf die Platte: da: Push the stone block onto the plate: walk into it and keep pushing. If it gets stuck, leave the room and come back.
daten.Schmale Stege über dem Abgrund. Stoß die: Narrow walkways over the chasm. Knock the foxes off - but don't let them knock you off!
daten.Finsternis. Irgendwo in der Mitte liegt: Darkness. Somewhere in the middle lies a plate that lights the torches. Sentries only look straight ahead.
daten.Blaue Pflöcke oben, orange unten. Du bra: Blue pegs at the top, orange at the bottom. You need both paths - and remember the Well Room: the color counts everywhere.
daten.Zwei Blöcke, zwei Reihen Graben. Erst de: Two blocks, two rows of trench. Push the lower one in first, then the upper one after it.
daten.Zeitschalter! Die Tür im Süden bleibt na: A timed plate! The south door only stays open for a moment after you step off. Run!
daten.Knaller explodieren kurz nach dem Treffe: Poppers explode shortly after being hit - get away! Their blast hits other enemies too.
daten.Der Riegel zur Torhalle lässt sich von h: From here you can slide back the bolt to the Gate Hall - a shortcut back to the entrance.
daten.Das Tor im Norden öffnet sich nur für ei: The north gate only opens for a sword. Behind the locked door to the west lives the Armored Boar - he guards one.
daten.Der Panzerkeiler! Sein Panzer ist zu har: The Armored Boar! His armor is too tough for your dagger. Make him charge into a wall or pillar - while dazed he is vulnerable.
daten.Der Keiler ist erledigt! In der Truhe gl: The boar is beaten! A sword gleams in the chest.
daten.Die Schützen stehen auf Inseln. Schlag i: The archers stand on islands. Knock their orbs back with your sword! Once both fall, the gate opens.
daten.Wächter sehen nur nach vorn. Erwisch den: Sentries only look straight ahead. Catch the captain at the top - when he falls, the key appears.
daten.Norden: Thronsaal - nur mit dem großen S: North: Throne Room - big key only. West and east: locked. The Tower Owl in the east guards the big key.
daten.Die Platte unten rechts öffnet das Tor i: The plate at the bottom right opens the west gate - but only briefly.
daten.Ein Nest! Teiler zerfallen in zwei. Halt: A nest! Splitters break in two. Hold the button until your sword sparkles - let go to clear everything around you.
daten.Drei Farben: Rot, Grün, Blau. Jeder Schl: Three colors: red, green, blue. Every strike moves all crystals on to the next color. Pegs stay up while their color is lit.
daten.Die Turmeule thront über dem Abgrund - u: The Tower Owl perches above the chasm - out of reach of any blade. Knock its orbs back with your sword! The pillars give cover.
daten.Der Schattenfuchs schimmert, solange er: The Shadow Fox shimmers while it attacks - then everything bounces off. Wait until it is exhausted. Popper blasts always hit it.
daten.Der Schattenfuchs! Das Ende der Fuchsfes: The Shadow Fox! The end of the Fox Fortress.
daten.Der Schattenfuchs ist besiegt - die Fuch: The Shadow Fox is defeated - the Fox Fortress is free! Thanks for playing.
